nodes.label: Prisma + Supabase Integration Pattern
nodes.rationale: Drizzle replaced by Prisma 7 + Supabase hosted Postgres. One ORM only. Prisma CLI uses DIRECT_DATABASE_URL (session pooler :5432) because the transaction pooler :6543 causes prepared-statement errors with Prisma CLI. Runtime app uses DATABASE_URL (transaction pooler :6543). Shell exports are overridden by .env loaded with override:true to avoid stale credential conflicts.

nodes.label: Pixel ×4 Scale Rule
nodes.rationale: Source assets are 16×16 (tiles) or 16×32 (pieces), displayed at ×4 = 64px cell. Integer scaling only (×4, ×8). Never fractional (×1.5, ×2.5). Nearest-neighbor filtering always — never bilinear/linear on game textures. image-rendering: pixelated for CSS sprites.

nodes.label: Monorepo Structure (pnpm + Turborepo)
nodes.rationale: pnpm workspaces + Turborepo 2.x (uses tasks, not pipeline). Build order: @chess/engine → client/server. Do not combine packageManager and devEngines.packageManager in package.json — Turborepo ignores packageManager and workspace resolution fails.

nodes.label: @chess/engine Package
nodes.rationale: Pure TS + Zod, no UI or server imports. Source of truth for all chess rules and card validators. Shared by both client and server. Provides applyAction() as public API, used server-side in production (not client-side in ranked matches).

nodes.label: Authoritative Server Rule
nodes.rationale: In ranked matches, the server applies all actions via @chess/engine. The client only applies actions locally in solo sandbox. This prevents cheating in competitive play.

nodes.label: PA (Points d'Action) System
nodes.rationale: Turn-based action point system inspired by Dofus. PA visible to opponent, predictable, scarce. No automatic PA ramp-up — generation is slow, conditional, and tightly controlled. PA can be consumed by cards or piece actions.

nodes.label: Card System (Deck + Draw + Timing)
nodes.rationale: Deck 10-15 cards. Draw 1 per turn. Empty deck reshuffles discard. Cards playable before/after piece moves. 5 reference cards from GDD §15 implement first: fracture_ligne, surcharge_tactique, sacrifice_calcule, champ_instable, decret_urgence.

nodes.label: Buildcraft System
nodes.rationale: Pre-game deck selection and passives/loadout construction. Players pick powers, passives, and optionally custom rules before each match. DB tables: decks, loadouts, rule_presets.

nodes.label: 8-bit Pixel Art Visual Direction
nodes.rationale: Direction: retro 8-bit readable with modern fluidity (references: Noita, Dead Cells). Four pillars: Pixel First (limited palette, no blurry vectors), Living Motion (easing/particles/shake), Game Readability (<1s to read a move/card/evolution), Consistency (same visual language board+UI).

nodes.label: Motion & Animation System
nodes.rationale: Piece moves: lerp ease-out ~150-250ms, optional arc on captures. Cards/powers: flash + short particles, never block screen >400ms without skip. Camera: short rare shake on major events (≤8px amplitude, ≤200ms). Idle: optional micro-movement (1-2px, slow cycle) — never distract from moves.

nodes.label: Socket.IO Real-time Contracts
nodes.rationale: Client→Server events: match:join, match:action, match:resign, match:ping. Server→Client events: match:state, match:error, match:ended, match:opponent_left, match:clock. Shared protocol exported from packages/shared with Zod schemas + protocolVersion.

nodes.label: Turn State Machine (GDD §14)
nodes.rationale: States: TurnStart (refresh PA, draw 1, start effects) → ActionPhase (play card/move piece/piece ability) → TurnEnd (resolve end effects, expire temporaries) → game over or loop. Implemented in packages/engine/src/regna/turn.ts.

nodes.label: Server Environment Variables
nodes.rationale: DATABASE_URL uses transaction pooler :6543 for runtime. DIRECT_DATABASE_URL uses session pooler :5432 for Prisma CLI. .env loaded with override:true to prevent stale shell exports from interfering. Never commit .env.

nodes.label: PWA Mobile-First Strategy
nodes.rationale: Single web responsive client covers PC, tablet, mobile via browser. PWA adds install capability (icon, fullscreen, cache) for near-native experience. Chose over Unity to avoid heavy WebGL, stay in TypeScript ecosystem. Uses @vite-pwa/nuxt (not abandoned @nuxtjs/pwa).

nodes.label: Sprite Asset Pipeline
nodes.rationale: All sprites at src/sprites/ repo root. Served via Nitro public asset alias /sprites/... Do NOT put runtime sprites under apps/client/public/. Path has space in 'chess pieces/' — always quote or encode.

nodes.label: Nuxt Client Routes
nodes.rationale: Routes: / (landing), /login (guest), /register (guest), /lobby (auth), /deck (auth), /loadout (auth), /play/[matchId] (auth, Pixi), /sandbox (auth), /profile (auth), /stats (auth), /history (auth), /leaderboard (public), /preset/[id] (public).

nodes.label: Product Roadmap Phases A-K
nodes.rationale: Phases: A (foundations), B (DB), C (auth), D (profile/stats), E (engine), F (client), G (REST API), H (realtime), I (matchmaking/ELO), J (full product loop), K (production). Milestones M0-M6. E+B parallelizable after A. Phase I blocked until C+B6+E4.

nodes.label: Chess Evolved Game Design Document
nodes.rationale: Three pillars: Buildcraft (pre-game army construction), Deep Strategy (synergies at high level), Controlled Surprise. Transformation level 6.5/10 — chess recognizable but all rules alterable. No inviolable rules. Target audience: players with chess basics + systemic game appreciation.

nodes.label: ELO Matchmaking System
nodes.rationale: ratings table per mode, default 1200. Private rooms (6-char code), ranked queue (rating-based matching). Future scale: migrate queue to Redis while keeping same service interface. ELO updates post-match.

nodes.label: packages/shared (Zod DTOs & Socket Events)
nodes.rationale: Exports Zod schemas, DTO types, Socket.IO event types, and protocolVersion. Shared between client and server via workspace:* dependency. Imports are compile-time type only (dotted lines in architecture diagram).

nodes.label: load-env.ts Override Pattern
nodes.rationale: apps/server/src/load-env.ts uses override:true so .env file always wins over shell exports. Prevents P1000/P1001 errors caused by stale exported DATABASE_URL/DIRECT_DATABASE_URL pointing to wrong host/password after Supabase password reset.

nodes.label: PixiJS Visual Scaffold
nodes.rationale: lib/visual, lib/pixi (nearest textures, layers, tween, camera shake, grid helpers), pixel-theme.css, /sprites nitro alias, home page preview. Validates full-pixel UI with m6x11 before board implementation.
